Treasurer’s Office
Our mission at the Scotts Bluff County Treasurer’s Office is to serve the public in a courteous, efficient, and helpful manner. The constituents of Scotts Bluff County are our priority.
Duties:
To collect all Revenues for the County
To bill and collect all Real Estate and Personal Property taxes in the County
Title all Motor Vehicles and Boats with situs in the County
Register all Motor Vehicles and Boats with situs in the County
To issue Driver Licenses, C.D.L.’s, learner permits, I.D. cards, school permits, provisional operator permits, etc.
To disburse collections to the proper Political Subdivisions
Auto Registration is a Department of the State of Nebraska that is operated by the County Treasurer’s Office.
